description.en: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (百炼) grants new-user free quota per model (usually 1M tokens, valid 90 days, Beijing region) plus 2,000 free calls/day via Qwen Code OAuth; OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh-Hans: 阿里云百炼为新用户发放各模型独立的免费额度（通常每模型 100 万 Token，有效期 90 天，华北2北京地域），另有 Qwen Code OAuth 每天 2,000 次免费调用；支持 OpenAI 兼容接口。

detail.en: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (百炼) is Alibaba Cloud's model service platform (Qwen and partner models). On first activation it automatically grants new-user free quota to each model (usually 1M tokens per model, valid for 90 days, Beijing region only); no real-name verification is needed to use the free quota, and unverified accounts default to hard stop when the quota runs out. Qwen Code OAuth authentication carries an independent free quota of 2,000 calls/day. The OpenAI-compatible endpoint can be connected to ChatSpeed.
detail.zh-Hans: 阿里云百炼是阿里云的大模型服务平台（千问 Qwen 及生态模型）。首次开通时自动为各模型发放新人免费额度（通常每模型 100 万 Token，有效期 90 天，仅华北2（北京）地域生效）；使用免费额度无需实名认证，未认证账号额度耗尽后默认触发用完即停（返回 403）。此外，Qwen Code 的 OAuth 认证提供独立于 API Key 体系的免费额度（每天 2,000 次调用）。通过 OpenAI 兼容端点可接入 ChatSpeed 使用。

provider.name: Bailian
provider.desc: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, OpenAI-compatible, with per-model new-user free quota.
